headline: Sensex surges over 1,500 points, Nifty reclaims 25,800 driven by FII inflows and lower crude oil

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign fund inflows and foreign institutional investor buying
Lower crude oil prices supporting Indian equities
Rally led by FMCG and private banking stocks
Positive momentum from reverse AI trade
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,500 points while Nifty reclaimed 25,800 and touched 25,951
November market gains helped Indian equities recoup nearly all losses recorded in 2026
Wipro was selected by BP to transform its core finance operations
US proposed a 17% tariff on India amidst proposed tariffs on China and Japan
summary: Indian share markets experienced a massive rally today, with Sensex surging over 1,500 points and Nifty crossing 25,800. The sharp uptick was driven by foreign fund inflows, falling crude oil prices, and strong buying in FMCG and private bank stocks. These November gains have helped Indian benchmark indices recover almost all losses suffered in 2026.
